column1: # ABOUTME: Measured wall-clock seconds per pierre-server integration test file.
# ABOUTME: Weights for the longest-processing-time shard packing in ci-postgres.yml.
# WEIGHTS ONLY. The set of files that runs always comes from
# `find crates/pierre-server/tests`, so a file absent here still runs — it is
# weighted at the p90 of this table so a new test is never assumed to be free.
# A stale entry costs balance, never coverage.
# The packer adds a per-file BUILD cost to every weight, including the ones
# here: a file that runs in 0.0s still has to be compiled and linked. Packing
# on run time alone put 259 near-zero files on one shard and cost it 148s of
